```{r, fig.cap="Distribution of Numerical Variables", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Histogram plots: numerical variables
raw_num_vars <- raw_data |>
  select(Poverty, BMI, BPSysAve, BPDiaAve, DirectChol, SleepHrsNight)

hist_plots <- map(names(raw_num_vars), function(v) {
  ggplot(raw_data, aes_string(x = v)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#377EB8", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)})

ggarrange(plotlist = hist_plots, ncol = 2, nrow = 3)
```
```{r, fig.cap="Distribution of Categorical Variables", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Barplots: categorical variables
raw_cat_vars <- raw_data %>%
  select(Race1, Education, MaritalStatus, Work, SleepTrouble, PhysActive, 
         Alcohol12PlusYr, Smoke100, HealthGen, LittleInterest, Depressed, Diabetes)

bar_plots <- map(names(raw_cat_vars), function(v) {
  ggplot(raw_data, aes_string(x = v)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
})

ggarrange(plotlist = bar_plots, ncol = 4, nrow = 3)
```

```{r, fig.cap="Correlation among Numeric Variables (Left) and Association among Categorical Variables (Right)", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Numeric correlation
num_vars <- clean_data |>
  select(Age, BMI, BPSysAve, BPDiaAve, DirectChol, SleepHrsNight)

cor_mat <- cor(num_vars, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
p_corr <- ggcorrplot(
  cor_mat,
  hc.order = FALSE,        
  type = "lower",          
  lab = TRUE,              
  lab_size = 3,
  colors = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[c(1,5,9)],  
  outline.col = "white",
  tl.col = "black")

# Cramer's V Heatmap
cat_vars <- clean_data |>
  select(Gender, Race1, Education, MaritalStatus, Poverty, Work, SleepTrouble, 
         PhysActive, Alcohol12PlusYr, Smoke100, HealthGen, LittleInterest, Depressed)

cramer_matrix <- sapply(cat_vars, function(x)
  sapply(cat_vars, function(y) CramerV(table(x, y))))
cramer_matrix <- round(cramer_matrix, 3)
rownames(cramer_matrix) <- colnames(cramer_matrix) <- names(cat_vars)

cramer_df <- melt(cramer_matrix, varnames = c("Var1", "Var2"), value.name = "value")

p_cramer <- ggplot(cramer_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = brewer.pal(9, "Blues"),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Cramér's V") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

(p_corr | p_cramer) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```
